data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name वैभव signifies the inner wealth and prosperity that comes from being connected to the divine. It reminds us that true happiness and fulfillment come from within, and that material possessions are just a reflection of the abundance that exists within us. Ultimately, the name वैभव is a reminder of the abundant grace and blessings of the Divine.

historical_references.reference:
The name 'वैभव' is mentioned in the ancient Indian epic 'Mahabharata'. It is the name of a king who ruled over the Anga country in the eastern part of India. The epics depict him as a just and virtuous ruler, revered by his subjects.
Time period: Circa 400 BC
Context: Mythology and ancient Indian literature

The name 'वैभव' is also mentioned in the medieval Hindu scripture 'Bhagavat Purana'. It is the name of one of the four principal kings who ruled over the four directions of the universe during the Satya Yuga, the first of four ages in Hindu cosmology. This king was in charge of the eastern direction.
Time period: Circa 10th century AD
Context: Hindu scripture and cosmology
